derivation: Induced from verified source previews; visual examples are references, not slide backgrounds

relationship_recipes.parallel: Equal weight items share a common baseline. Three short items use one row; never leave a lone tile in a 2x2 grid.
relationship_recipes.process: Steps form one directional sequence; connector and step count change together.
relationship_recipes.comparison: Use paired aligned dimensions. Unequal content uses a narrative layout instead of empty opposing cards.
relationship_recipes.data: Show value, unit, period and source; do not inflate short values into large empty cards.
relationship_recipes.hierarchy: Place a single conclusion above or beside supporting items; do not imply equal weight.

cards.auto: 2–3 项同权内容用无衬底开放分栏；其他项数默认网格；六项连续重复网格时，可由整稿选版改为开放式两行分组

process.auto: 3–5 步且每步说明不超过 22 显示宽度单位时用开放轨道；较长说明用有衬底的阶段卡

priority_grid.auto: 4 条短支撑信息用上方主结论＋下方四栏；其他情况用左主右辅

milestone_timeline.auto: 3–4 个里程碑用横向时间轴；5–6 个用纵向列表避免横向拥挤

bullets.auto: 2–3 项且内容较短用 spacious；5–6 项或有长项用 compact；其余用 balanced；有 featured_index 用 lead

metrics.auto: 单项用 hero；有 featured_index 且至少两项用 lead_support；其余用 grid

comparison.before_after: 两侧同一对象的改造前后，并提供材料中的变化结论

data_table.action_tracker: 每行包含问题、措施、责任人、期限和状态；固定五列直角表格

image_case.annotated: 来源截图上标注一至三个点，并在右侧逐点解释

style_specific.blue: Light background, flat blue divider and restrained borders; source examples keep aligned content groups.
style_specific.red: White background, restrained red emphasis and flat dividers; avoid broad filled blocks.
style_specific.deep-blue-tech: Dark layered background and blue-cyan accents; no white simple-style cards.
